steps.action: Inventory dependencies, credentials, security controls and compatibility; document every assumption.
Create an encrypted backup and prove restoration in isolation.
Rehearse migration and verify schema, checksums, permissions and rollback.
Schedule an approved maintenance window and notify stakeholders.
Migrate through encrypted channels while the source remains intact.
Verify integrity, access controls, encryption and service health.
If acceptance fails, route traffic to the intact source and restore the verified backup.
